command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=1be1a8dd889cec5cdf8484f33157a0294861b37f
PROD=20f3ab645d4be384a6f20073330f2744694b7c4b
cd "$HOME/local-agent"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PROD"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
git fetch --quiet origin v4.13.0-staging
test "$(git rev-parse origin/v4.13.0-staging)" = "$BASE"
WT=/tmp/local-agent-v413-release-v2
git worktree prune
rm -rf "$WT"
git worktree add --force --quiet --detach "$WT" "$BASE"
cd "$WT"
printf '%s' '' | base64 -D > /tmp/local_agent_v413_patch.py
python3 /tmp/local_agent_v413_patch.py
git diff --check
python3 -m py_compile agentd.py agent_config.py agent_core.py agent_runtime.py agent_process.py agent_repository.py agent_repo_worker.py agent_multirepo.py agent_parallel.py agent_parallel_worker.py agent_repo_admin.py agent_storage.py agentctl.py agent_version.py
if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check agentd.py agent_config.py agent_core.py agent_runtime.py agent_process.py agent_repository.py agent_repo_worker.py agent_multirepo.py agent_parallel.py agent_parallel_worker.py agent_repo_admin.py agent_storage.py agentctl.py agent_version.py tests; fi
node chat_bridge/control_protocol.test.js
node chat_bridge/bridge_state.test.js
node chat_bridge/service_worker.test.js
env -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_FDS -u LOCAL_AGENT_LEASE_KEYS_DIGEST python3 -m unittest discover -q
git add -- AGENTS.md README.md docs/OPERATIONS.md docs/GOLDEN_STANDARD.md docs/RELEASE_NOTES_V4.13.0.md agent_version.py
git commit -m 'Finalize v4.13 resource admission contract'
git push origin HEAD:v4.13.0-staging
echo V413_CANDIDATE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
cd "$HOME/local-agent"
git worktree remove --force "$WT"
